Help Us Celebrate 100 Years of Memorial Hall
Published on June 02, 2025
Friday, May 30, 2025, marked the 100-year dedication anniversary for the Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Building or Memorial Hall in downtown KCK (600 N. 7th Street, KCK, KS). In honor of this iconic building, the (UG), along with various organizations and volunteers, are excited to invite the community to a two-day centennial celebration this September.
Tagged as: , Announcements , Arts & Culture , Events & Activities , Honors & Celebration , Media Releases , Open House
Vendors Wanted for the Upcoming Memorial Hall Centennial Celebration
Published on August 08, 2025
The Unified Government, in partnership with Downtown Shareholders and the Toolbox: Small Business Resource Center, invites local business owners and entrepreneurs to participate in the upcoming Memorial Hall Centennial Celebration on September 12, 2025. - Interested business owners should complete an application for consideration before the deadline of August 26, 2025.
Tagged as: , Announcements , Arts & Culture , Business & Economy , Events & Activities , Honors & Celebration , Media Releases
Help Us Celebrate 100 Years of the Iconic Memorial Hall This Friday
Published on September 08, 2025
The UG, in partnership with the Downtown Shareholders and a host of community organizations, are excited to host a special Centennial Celebration honoring the 100th anniversary of the historic Soldiers and Sailors Memorial, now known to many as Memorial Hall in downtown Kansas City, Kansas (600 N. 7th Street, KCK). Happening on Friday, September 12, 2025, from 5:30PM to 8:30PM.
